caption: Figure 1. The four-question Diagnostic Information Profile and an appendicitis worked example. The framework separates performance, expectation, observation, and action. The example is a source-defined meta-analytic test group with incomplete defining metadata: the review title identifies non-contrast CT; the recorded test_name is ‘Overall structured 2 x 2 data’; no separate index-test positivity threshold was recorded. Across n=11 studies, primary continuity-corrected bivariate REML estimated sensitivity (Se) 91.7% (approximate model-based 95% pooled-mean interval (PMI) 88.1–94.3%; predictive range (PR) 80.7–96.7%) and specificity (Sp) 96.1% (PMI 93.2–97.8%; PR 83.0–99.2%). At the illustrative 20% starting probability, expected information was 0.478 bits (PMI 0.397–0.541; PR 0.215–0.625). No action was selected because consequence, preference, cost, and alternative inputs were absent. Intervals are plug-in model summaries conditional on fitted heterogeneity; the tied appendicitis log-L11 boundary solution makes joint predictive ranges especially fragile.

caption: Figure S4. Primary continuity-corrected bivariate REML limited recovery/smoke diagnostic and fit diagnostics. (A–B) In 24 scenarios with one dataset each, pooled-mean intervals included the generating sensitivity (Se) and specificity (Sp) in 87.5% and 87.5%; this is not repeated-sampling coverage. Intervals are approximate plug-in model summaries conditional on fitted heterogeneity; heterogeneity-parameter uncertainty was not propagated and predictive ranges were not checked. (C) Older diagnostics: 69 boundary correlations, 9 near-singular covariance estimates, and 1 elevated raw gradients. (D) Numerical ties included 6 log-L00 and 73 log-L11 boundary endpoints across 73 fits; selected endpoints included 6 and 70, respectively. A tied boundary endpoint signals fragility even when the selected endpoint is interior. Seven tied-boundary fits were missed by older flags, and the overall union is 77. Appendicitis has a tied log-L11 boundary solution and selected correlation 1.000; its joint predictive ranges are fragile.
